project.name: ai-coding-java
project.purpose: Personal reusable enterprise Java AI Coding component for onboarding, rule routing, verification evidence, review output, and lightweight pre-commit protection.

techStack.runtime: Documentation/template component; no Java runtime build currently.
techStack.python: Use the machine global Python only for helper scripts.

notes: The component itself is intended to be versioned in Git.
Injected business-project templates may be local-only or committed according to the target project policy.
Phase 1 now includes concrete rules, workflow, and templates directories.
Phase 2 now includes target project initialization script, profile template, AGENTS snippet template, and examples.
Phase 3 now includes a lightweight deterministic static review script and good/bad fixtures.
Phase 4 now includes a sanitized knowledge base structure and a delivery-report-to-knowledge-candidate script.
Phase 5 now includes optional lightweight RD integration docs, artifact guidance, and requirement/design/test/release-impact brief templates.
Phase 6 now auto-installs a lightweight Git pre-commit hook that scans staged files and blocks only deterministic P0 findings.
Target project generated support files should stay under .ai-coding-java/ by default; only reviewed AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md snippets should touch the target root.
Codex recognizes target rules through AGENTS.md; Claude Code recognizes target rules through CLAUDE.md or an explicit CLAUDE-to-AGENTS delegation.
directives: Keep AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md compact and aligned.
Do not copy global skill catalogs, model routing tables, unrelated gate systems, or lifecycle hook stacks into this component by default.
Do not add RD phase gates, metric reporting, or platform hooks unless the user explicitly requests that phase.
Use setup-ai-coding as the general initialization skill name; keep setup-cc only as a compatibility alias.
